subject: MAP checkpoint: OK-to-commence decision path and paperchain plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP checkpoint: OK-to-commence decision path and paperchain plan

Samir —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation week. Per the MAP, engineering tests, latency benchmarks, and the security questionnaire are complete and we have a single outstanding procurement item (data retention wording) in the SOW redlines. Attached: MAP-v4.xlsx and SOW_v2_redlines.pdf.

Proposed final steps so we can lock the start date and allocation:
- Legal signoff on the tiny data-retention tweak (Lauren) — target: EOD Mon 8/29
- DocuSign envelope sent Wed 9/1 morning PT for signatures (Ben to send)
- Target customer signature window: 9/1 - 9/3
- Target production start: 2027-09-06 (Monday)

Can you confirm that procurement can review the redline and that BrightCart is able to do signature between 9/1–9/3? If you want an earlier start date we can try to accelerate the DocuSign send, but schedule above gives legal & PO time.

If OK I’ll mark this as the "OK-to-commence" checkpoint in the MAP and Ben will prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai]

Attachments: MAP-v4.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_v2_redlines.pdf (redlined PDF)

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightcart.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: OK-to-commence decision path and paperchain plan

Jasmine — thanks for the clear runbook. We ran the redlines by procurement and they have one ask: can we tweak the proposed start date to 2027-09-05 (first business day for our onboarding team) instead of 09-06? It's mainly scheduling on their side (training cohort).

Also, procurement will want to confirm the final data-retention wording — I’ve looped them in. They aim to respond by Monday 8/29 EOD. If that timing works, procurement is comfortable with DocuSign Wed 9/1.

Quick confirmation: once signed, will Redwood confirm the onboarding kickoff calendar and a dedicated 1-hour kickoff with our infra & platform owners?

—Samir
Samir Khan
Director, Cloud Architecture — BrightCart
samir.khan@brightcart.com

On Wed, Aug 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-25T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: OK-to-commence decision path and paperchain plan

Folks —

I reviewed SOW_v2_redlines.pdf. The requested data-retention language from BrightCart is reasonable; I incorporated a narrow clause to clarify retention limits and audit access. I’ve attached SOW_final_for_sig.pdf (clean copy for signature) and added a single comment for internal visibility.

Two notes:
1) We should confirm procurement contacts for the DocuSign routing (Samir cc'd procurement team — great). If procurement requires PO, Ben please confirm the PO process & billing contact so we can include it in the envelope routing.
2) If BrightCart requests a 09/05 start, that's fine from a legal perspective — just ensure the timeline in the SOW table reflects the agreed start date.

Otherwise I recommend we move to DocuSign on 9/1 as planned.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_final_for_sig.pdf (clean SOW)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-25T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: OK-to-commence decision path and paperchain plan

Samir / Team —

Thanks — Ben here. Per legal's greenlight (thanks Lauren) I'll create the DocuSign envelope on Wed 2027-09-01 at 9:00 AM PT and route to the primary signer Samir, then to BrightCart procurement for the PO acknowledgement. Please confirm the procurement contact name & billing email and I'll add them to the envelope routing.

DocuSign link (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/BRG-7421/envelope
MAP milestone update: I will mark "OK-to-commence" in the MAP spreadsheet the moment signatures are in flight. Once signed, Rafael (cc) will book the onboarding kickoff and share calendar invites for the 1-hour infra/platform session and the technical deep dive.

If you want DocuSign sent earlier I can kick it off tomorrow but given procurement's Monday turnaround 9/1 seems safest.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: none

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@brightcart.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, BrightCart Procurement <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint: OK-to-commence decision path and paperchain plan

Ben / Jasmine —

All good from BrightCart. Procurement confirms they will finish review by EOD Mon 8/29. Please use procurement@brightcart.com (cc'd) as the billing/PO contact in the DocuSign envelope. We prefer start date 2027-09-05 — that works for training schedules.

This serves as our informal GO. Once we have the DocuSign envelope I will countersign promptly (aiming 9/1–9/3). Rafael — please send the kickoff calendar and any pre-kick materials to my team after signatures.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

—Samir
Samir Khan
Director, Cloud Architecture — BrightCart
samir.khan@brightcart.com
